title: महाधिवेशनको पूर्वसन्ध्यामा थापा–पाण्डे समूहलाई काउन्टर दिन लिङ्देन निकट नेताहरू जिल्ला भ्रमणमा जाँदै
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । राष्ट्रिय प्रजातन्त्र पार्टी (राप्रपा)मा महाधिवेशनको तयारी तीव्र गतिमा अगाडी बढेको छ। महाधिवेशनको मिति नजिकिएसँगै राप्रपामा संस्थापन र इतर पक्षबीच चर्को प्रतिस्पर्धा देखिन थालेको छ। पूर्वअध्यक्ष कमल थापासहितका नेताहरू विभिन्न जिल्लाको भ्रमण सकिनासाथ अध्यक्ष राजेन्द्र लिङ्देन निकटका दोस्रो पुस्ताका नेताहरू पनि निस्कन लागेका हुन्। थापा समूहलाई काउन्टर दिने गरी लिङ्देन निकट मानिएका नेताहरूले तराई मधेस र गण्डकी प्रदेशको यात्रामा जान लागेका हुन्। यसअघि पूर्वअध्यक्षद्वय थापा र प्रकाशचन्द्र लोहनी तथा वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष विक्रम पाण्डेले वीरगञ्जदेखि झापासम्मको एक साता लामो अभियान चलाएका थिए। इतर समूहले पाण्डेलाई अध्यक्षमा उतार्ने तयारी गरेको छ। पूर्वअध्यक्ष थापासहित नेताहरूले अभियानका क्रममा लिङ्देनको कारणले पार्टी कमजोर अवस्थामा पुगेको आरोप लगाएका थिए। थापाले आगामी स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचनमा उम्मेदवार समेत नपाउने अवस्थामा राप्रपा पुगेको टिप्पणी गरेका थिए। अहिले पनि थापा समूह विभिन्न जिल्ला भ्रमणमा केन्द्रित छ। थापा समूह जिल्लाको भ्रमणमै रहेको बेलामा लिङ्देन निकटका नेताहरूको समेत जिल्ला दौडाहामा निस्कन लागेकाले राप्रपामा महाधिवेशनको सरगर्मी बढेको नेता कार्यकर्ता बताउँछन्। महाधिवेशनको पूर्वसन्ध्यामा अघिल्लो पुस्ताका नेताहरूले पार्टी र नेतृत्वबारे दिइएका अभिव्यक्तिले कार्यकर्ता पङ्क्तिमा भ्रम पैदा गर्न खोजेकाले त्यसलाई चिर्न आफूहरू मधेस यात्रामा निस्कन लागेको नेतृ खुस्बु ओलीले बताइन्। प्रतिनिधि सभाकी सांसद ओलीको नेतृत्वमा नयाँ पुस्ताका युवाहरू नेताहरूले तराई मधेसका विभिन्न जिल्लामा आयोजित कार्यक्रममा सहभागी हुने तय भएको छ। महामन्त्री राजेन्द्र गुरुङ नेतृत्वको टोली मंसिर पहिलो हप्ता गण्डकी प्रदेशमा जानेछ। अभियानको क्रममा पार्टीविरुद्धको भ्रम चिर्ने, गण्डकी र तराई मधेसका विभिन्न तहका नेता, कार्यकर्तासँग संवाद र अन्तरक्रिया गर्ने ओलीले बताइन्। यात्राका क्रममा राष्ट्रिय राजनीतिमा राप्रपाको भूमिका र औचित्यबारे छलफल गर्ने, पार्टीको नीति, विचार, सिद्धान्त र नेतृत्वबारे प्रस्ट पार्ने समेत बताइन्। यो समूहले आउँदै गरेको आठौँ महाधिवेशनमा राजेन्द्र लिङ्देनलाई नै अध्यक्षमा दोहोर्‍याउने तयारी छ। लिङ्देननिकट एक नेताले भने, ‘राप्रपाको दीर्घकालीन भविष्यका लागि अध्यक्षमा उहाँको विकल्प छैन। पार्टी विधानले उहाँलाई त्यो सुविधा पनि दिएको छ, शून्यमा पुगेको पार्टीलाई नै उहाँले यहाँसम्म ल्याउनुभएको हो।’ तराई मधेस यात्रामा हालैको निर्वाचनमा काठमाडौं ६ मा उम्मेदवार रहेका उद्धवराज भेटुवाल, धनकुटामा उम्मेदवार रहेका विभत्सु थापा लगायतका युवा नेताहरू पनि सहभागी हुनेछन्। थापा युवा व्यवसायी र राप्रपाका संस्थापक अध्यक्ष सूर्यबहादुर थापाका नाति हुन्। अभियानमा मधेसका प्रदेशका सहमहामन्त्री मोहन यादवलगायतका नेताहरूको समेत यात्रामा सहभागिता हुनेछन्। मधेस यात्रा मंसिर १ गते सप्तरी र सिराहा, मंसिर २ गते धनुषा र महोत्तरी, मंसिर ३ गते सर्लाही र रौतहट, मंसिर ४ गते बारा र पर्सामा हुने भ्रमण दलमा रहेका नेता थापाले बताए। महामन्त्री गुरुङ नेतृत्वको टोली गण्डकी प्रदेशका विभिन्न जिल्लामा जानेछ। गुरुङको टोली तनहुँ, लमजुङ, गोरखा, कास्की हुँदै स्याङ्जा, पर्वत, बागलुङ, म्याग्दी र मुस्ताङका नेता, कार्यकर्तासँग संवाद र अन्तरक्रिया गर्नेछ। गुरुङको टोलीमा युवा नेता जनकराज पाठक, गत निर्वाचनका बागलुङका उम्मेदवारहरू अञ्चल शाही, कल्याण विक्रम आचार्य, ललितपुर १ का उम्मेदवार इ. सजीना कार्कीलगायतका युवाहरूको सहभागिता रहने तय भएकाे छ। Kathmandu. Preparations for the general convention of the Rastriya Prajatantra Party (RPP) are progressing at a rapid pace. As the date of the general convention approaches, fierce competition has begun to be seen between the establishment and other parties in the RPP. As soon as former chairman Kamal Thapa and other leaders have completed their tour of various districts, second-generation leaders close to chairman Rajendra Lingden are also set to leave. Leaders considered close to Lingden are set to travel to the Terai Madhes and Gandaki provinces to counter the Thapa group. Earlier, former presidents Thapa and Prakash Chandra Lohani and senior vice president Bikram Pandey had launched a week-long campaign from Birgunj to Jhapa. Leaders including former chairman Thapa had alleged during the campaign that the party had reached a weak state due to Lingden. Thapa had commented that the RPP had reached a point where it would not even be able to field candidates in the upcoming local elections. Even now, the Thapa group is focused on visiting various districts. Leaders and cadres say that the excitement for the general convention has increased in the RPP as leaders close to Lingden are also starting to travel to the district while the Thapa group is on a tour of the district. Leader Khusbu Oli said that they are embarking on a Madhes Yatra to overcome the confusion that the previous generation of leaders had created among the cadres with their statements about the party and leadership on the eve of the general convention. It has been decided that the new generation of youth leaders, led by Oli, a member of the House of Representatives, will participate in programs organized in various districts of Terai Madhes. A team led by General Secretary Rajendra Gurung will go to Gandaki Province in the first week of November. Oli said that during the campaign, she will dispel misconceptions against the party, and will hold dialogues and interactions with leaders and cadres from various levels of Gandaki and Tarai Madhes. She also said that during the trip, she will discuss the role and relevance of the RPP in national politics, and clarify the party's policies, ideas, principles, and leadership. This group is preparing to re-elect Rajendra Lingden as its president at the upcoming eighth general convention. A leader close to Lingden said, "There is no alternative to him as the chairman for the long-term future of the RPP. The party constitution has also given him that facility. He is the one who brought the party, which had reached zero, to this point." Young leaders including Uddhav Raj Bhetuwal, who was a candidate in Kathmandu 6 in the recent elections, and Bibhatsu Thapa, who was a candidate in Dhankuta, will also participate in the Tarai Madhesh Yatra. Thapa is the grandson of young businessman and founding chairman of the RPP, Surya Bahadur Thapa. Leaders including Joint General Secretary of Madhesh Province Mohan Yadav will also participate in the campaign. Leader Thapa, who is part of the visiting party, said that the Madhesh Yatra will be held in Saptari and Siraha on Mangsir 1, Dhanusha and Mahottari on Mangsir 2, Sarlahi and Rautahat on Mangsir 3, and Bara and Parsa on Mangsir 4. A team led by General Secretary Gurung will travel to various districts of Gandaki Province. Gurung's team will conduct dialogue and interaction with leaders and cadres of Syangja, Parbat, Baglung, Myagdi and Mustang via Tanahun, Lamjung, Gorkha, Kaski. Gurung's team is set to include youth leader Janak Raj Pathak, Baglung candidates from the last election Anchal Shahi, Kalyan Bikram Acharya, Lalitpur 1 candidate E. Sajina Karki and other youth.

पूर्वअध्यक्ष कमल थापासहितका नेताहरू विभिन्न जिल्लाको भ्रमण सकिनासाथ अध्यक्ष राजेन्द्र लिङ्देन निकटका दोस्रो पुस्ताका नेताहरू पनि निस्कन लागेका हुन्। थापा समूहलाई काउन्टर दिने गरी लिङ्देन निकट मानिएका नेताहरूले तराई मधेस र गण्डकी प्रदेशको यात्रामा जान लागेका हुन्।

यसअघि पूर्वअध्यक्षद्वय थापा र प्रकाशचन्द्र लोहनी तथा वरिष्ठ उपाध्यक्ष विक्रम पाण्डेले वीरगञ्जदेखि झापासम्मको एक साता लामो अभियान चलाएका थिए। इतर समूहले पाण्डेलाई अध्यक्षमा उतार्ने तयारी गरेको छ।

पूर्वअध्यक्ष थापासहित नेताहरूले अभियानका क्रममा लिङ्देनको कारणले पार्टी कमजोर अवस्थामा पुगेको आरोप लगाएका थिए। थापाले आगामी स्थानीय तहको निर्वाचनमा उम्मेदवार समेत नपाउने अवस्थामा राप्रपा पुगेको टिप्पणी गरेका थिए। अहिले पनि थापा समूह विभिन्न जिल्ला भ्रमणमा केन्द्रित छ।

थापा समूह जिल्लाको भ्रमणमै रहेको बेलामा लिङ्देन निकटका नेताहरूको समेत जिल्ला दौडाहामा निस्कन लागेकाले राप्रपामा महाधिवेशनको सरगर्मी बढेको नेता कार्यकर्ता बताउँछन्।

महाधिवेशनको पूर्वसन्ध्यामा अघिल्लो पुस्ताका नेताहरूले पार्टी र नेतृत्वबारे दिइएका अभिव्यक्तिले कार्यकर्ता पङ्क्तिमा भ्रम पैदा गर्न खोजेकाले त्यसलाई चिर्न आफूहरू मधेस यात्रामा निस्कन लागेको नेतृ खुस्बु ओलीले बताइन्।

प्रतिनिधि सभाकी सांसद ओलीको नेतृत्वमा नयाँ पुस्ताका युवाहरू नेताहरूले तराई मधेसका विभिन्न जिल्लामा आयोजित कार्यक्रममा सहभागी हुने तय भएको छ। महामन्त्री राजेन्द्र गुरुङ नेतृत्वको टोली मंसिर पहिलो हप्ता गण्डकी प्रदेशमा जानेछ।

अभियानको क्रममा पार्टीविरुद्धको भ्रम चिर्ने, गण्डकी र तराई मधेसका विभिन्न तहका नेता, कार्यकर्तासँग संवाद र अन्तरक्रिया गर्ने ओलीले बताइन्। यात्राका क्रममा राष्ट्रिय राजनीतिमा राप्रपाको भूमिका र औचित्यबारे छलफल गर्ने, पार्टीको नीति, विचार, सिद्धान्त र नेतृत्वबारे प्रस्ट पार्ने समेत बताइन्।

यो समूहले आउँदै गरेको आठौँ महाधिवेशनमा राजेन्द्र लिङ्देनलाई नै अध्यक्षमा दोहोर्‍याउने तयारी छ।

लिङ्देननिकट एक नेताले भने, ‘राप्रपाको दीर्घकालीन भविष्यका लागि अध्यक्षमा उहाँको विकल्प छैन। पार्टी विधानले उहाँलाई त्यो सुविधा पनि दिएको छ, शून्यमा पुगेको पार्टीलाई नै उहाँले यहाँसम्म ल्याउनुभएको हो।’

तराई मधेस यात्रामा हालैको निर्वाचनमा काठमाडौं ६ मा उम्मेदवार रहेका उद्धवराज भेटुवाल, धनकुटामा उम्मेदवार रहेका विभत्सु थापा लगायतका युवा नेताहरू पनि सहभागी हुनेछन्। थापा युवा व्यवसायी र राप्रपाका संस्थापक अध्यक्ष सूर्यबहादुर थापाका नाति हुन्।

अभियानमा मधेसका प्रदेशका सहमहामन्त्री मोहन यादवलगायतका नेताहरूको समेत यात्रामा सहभागिता हुनेछन्। मधेस यात्रा मंसिर १ गते सप्तरी र सिराहा, मंसिर २ गते धनुषा र महोत्तरी, मंसिर ३ गते सर्लाही र रौतहट, मंसिर ४ गते बारा र पर्सामा हुने भ्रमण दलमा रहेका नेता थापाले बताए।

महामन्त्री गुरुङ नेतृत्वको टोली गण्डकी प्रदेशका विभिन्न जिल्लामा जानेछ। गुरुङको टोली तनहुँ, लमजुङ, गोरखा, कास्की हुँदै स्याङ्जा, पर्वत, बागलुङ, म्याग्दी र मुस्ताङका नेता, कार्यकर्तासँग संवाद र अन्तरक्रिया गर्नेछ।

गुरुङको टोलीमा युवा नेता जनकराज पाठक, गत निर्वाचनका बागलुङका उम्मेदवारहरू अञ्चल शाही, कल्याण विक्रम आचार्य, ललितपुर १ का उम्मेदवार इ. सजीना कार्कीलगायतका युवाहरूको सहभागिता रहने तय भएकाे छ।

Kathmandu. Preparations for the general convention of the Rastriya Prajatantra Party (RPP) are progressing at a rapid pace. As the date of the general convention approaches, fierce competition has begun to be seen between the establishment and other parties in the RPP. As soon as former chairman Kamal Thapa and other leaders have completed their tour of various districts, second-generation leaders close to chairman Rajendra Lingden are also set to leave. Leaders considered close to Lingden are set to travel to the Terai Madhes and Gandaki provinces to counter the Thapa group. Earlier, former presidents Thapa and Prakash Chandra Lohani and senior vice president Bikram Pandey had launched a week-long campaign from Birgunj to Jhapa. Leaders including former chairman Thapa had alleged during the campaign that the party had reached a weak state due to Lingden. Thapa had commented that the RPP had reached a point where it would not even be able to field candidates in the upcoming local elections. Even now, the Thapa group is focused on visiting various districts. Leaders and cadres say that the excitement for the general convention has increased in the RPP as leaders close to Lingden are also starting to travel to the district while the Thapa group is on a tour of the district. Leader Khusbu Oli said that they are embarking on a Madhes Yatra to overcome the confusion that the previous generation of leaders had created among the cadres with their statements about the party and leadership on the eve of the general convention. It has been decided that the new generation of youth leaders, led by Oli, a member of the House of Representatives, will participate in programs organized in various districts of Terai Madhes. A team led by General Secretary Rajendra Gurung will go to Gandaki Province in the first week of November. Oli said that during the campaign, she will dispel misconceptions against the party, and will hold dialogues and interactions with leaders and cadres from various levels of Gandaki and Tarai Madhes. She also said that during the trip, she will discuss the role and relevance of the RPP in national politics, and clarify the party's policies, ideas, principles, and leadership. This group is preparing to re-elect Rajendra Lingden as its president at the upcoming eighth general convention. A leader close to Lingden said, "There is no alternative to him as the chairman for the long-term future of the RPP. The party constitution has also given him that facility. He is the one who brought the party, which had reached zero, to this point." Young leaders including Uddhav Raj Bhetuwal, who was a candidate in Kathmandu 6 in the recent elections, and Bibhatsu Thapa, who was a candidate in Dhankuta, will also participate in the Tarai Madhesh Yatra. Thapa is the grandson of young businessman and founding chairman of the RPP, Surya Bahadur Thapa. Leaders including Joint General Secretary of Madhesh Province Mohan Yadav will also participate in the campaign. Leader Thapa, who is part of the visiting party, said that the Madhesh Yatra will be held in Saptari and Siraha on Mangsir 1, Dhanusha and Mahottari on Mangsir 2, Sarlahi and Rautahat on Mangsir 3, and Bara and Parsa on Mangsir 4. A team led by General Secretary Gurung will travel to various districts of Gandaki Province. Gurung's team will conduct dialogue and interaction with leaders and cadres of Syangja, Parbat, Baglung, Myagdi and Mustang via Tanahun, Lamjung, Gorkha, Kaski. Gurung's team is set to include youth leader Janak Raj Pathak, Baglung candidates from the last election Anchal Shahi, Kalyan Bikram Acharya, Lalitpur 1 candidate E. Sajina Karki and other youth.
